title: Zee Scott's "Open" is a daring record from an artist that is ready for the world
htmlContent:
Zee Scott's "Open" is a daring record from an artist that is ready for the world. He approaches the music with no fear, and it’s ever so apparent in the music. It’s an unapologetic piece of audio art, that showcases his talent to the fullest, while giving that soul to the record that his fans will be able to come to for a lifetime.
